articles.summary: BOULDER, Colorado—May 2, 2018 — OnKure, Inc., the epigenetics–focused drug discovery and development company that is advancing the first Largazole-derived, histone deacetylase inhibitor into Phase 1 clinical trials, announced that it has completed a $7M Series A financing.
